sources.title: SpAItial Announces Echo-2 for Real-Time 3D Scene Generation
sources.snippet: What's the story? SpAItial has announced Echo-2, a model that generates real-time, navigable 3D scenes from text or image inputs. Why it matters The model could support faster creation of interactive 3D scenes for robotics, architecture, digital twins, and immersive content. The bigger picture Echo-2 shows how text and image-based generation is moving beyond flat media toward interactive ...

sources.title: Echo-2: Physically-grounded 3D World Generation - spaitial.ai
sources.snippet: Echo-2 is our best frontier model for generating stunning, 3D-consistent worlds from text or image inputs, explorable in real time from any device.
